answer.reason: The verses tell of Ahaz's siege by Syria and Israel, his gift of temple treasure to Assyria, and the altar he had copied from Damascus.

clauses.english: was besieged at Jerusalem by Rezin and Pekah but was not overcome
clauses.quote: they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him

clauses.english: sent the silver and gold of the LORD's house to the king of Assyria
clauses.quote: took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD

clauses.english: had an altar built after the pattern of one at Damascus
clauses.quote: Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent

doubts: ISA 14:28 and ISA 7:1 and 2CH 28:19 call Ahaz king of Israel or only date events by him; used only 2KI for the clauses.
The dial of Ahaz (2KI 20:11, ISA 38:8) is an object named for him, not a deed of Ahaz, so it was left out.
